# Domain Pack — Player (CFTS025) — SWE1 分析綜整 v2
## Glossary
- term: Player subgroup | definition: 共用 Source Control events 的來源:External CD、HU AUX、HU USB、HU BTSA
- term: Now Playing playlist | definition: 當前播放清單;Repeat/Shuffle 都作用於此
- term: Repeat All | definition: 預設;依序播完整清單後自動從第一首繼續。softkey 高亮/ON,標籤『Repeat All』(HMI PC4.1 優先於 CFTS,PLA-006-01/02, 009 裁決)
- term: Repeat Song | definition: 重複當前曲目(到結尾重頭播)。softkey 顯示 ON 態(PLA-006-03, 008)
- term: Shuffle On/Off | definition: On=Now Playing 隨機序;Off=正常序(PLA-010-02/03)
- term: Alphajump | definition: 字母快跳;只啟用清單首字母對應的字元(Intelligent Character Filtering, PLA-014-03/016-03)
- term: DAP / MSC | definition: USB DAP(Database Audio Player,類別瀏覽)與 USB MSC(Mass Storage,資料夾/檔案瀏覽)
- term: Source / Audio Tab | definition: AUX 模式下唯一可用的兩個 tab,其餘控制 greyed out(PLA-004)
- term: Showroom Demo Video | definition: Dealer Mode 下的展示影片;行為定義於 CFTS012(Dealer),非 Player CFTS091。Player PLA-052 僅為跨文件指標 stub

- feature: Error popups | normal: 播放支援檔 | abnormal: No Supported Files→PU0003;USB File Read Error→PU0024;其他一律 Generic Error→PU0005(存在期間持續顯示) | boundary: 三類錯誤對應三個 PU ID;PU0005 為 catch-all
- feature: AUX | normal: 播放 AUX | abnormal: 無 command & control | boundary: 只有 Source/Audio Tab 可用,其餘 greyed out(PLA-004)
- feature: Repeat | normal: 預設 Repeat All;softkey toggle All↔Song | abnormal: — | boundary: 恰兩態,兩態 softkey 皆『高亮/ON』,差別在標籤:All(預設,標籤『Repeat All』)/ Song(標籤『Repeat Song』)。無 'Off/No Repeat' 態。CFTS 字面寫 Repeat All=OFF,但 HMI(PC4.1)優先於 CFTS,SWE1-PLA-009 已裁決以 HMI 為準=高亮
- feature: Shuffle | normal: toggle On/Off | abnormal: — | boundary: 二元:On(隨機)/ Off(正常序)
- feature: Metadata | normal: 顯示/隱藏切換(PLA-011) | abnormal: BTSA metadata 不支援時的顯示(PLA-019) | boundary: —
- feature: Track List ('trks') | normal: 顯示 Now Playing 清單、可導航、選曲播放(PLA-012-01/02/03) | abnormal: — | boundary: —
- feature: Folder/File Nav | normal: USB MSC 資料夾/檔案瀏覽(PLA-013) | abnormal: — | boundary: —
- feature: Alphajump (MSC & DAP) | normal: 啟用 softkey→顯示字母畫面→選字母重定位(PLA-014/016 各 5 子項) | abnormal: Cancel softkey 取消 | boundary: 只啟用清單存在首字母的字元(Intelligent Character Filtering)
- feature: DAP Category Nav | normal: 類別瀏覽(PLA-015) | abnormal: — | boundary: —
- feature: Browse Tab | normal: 捲動(PLA-017)、選 menu item / playable item(PLA-018-01/02) | abnormal: — | boundary: menu item vs playable item 兩種選取行為
- feature: Demo Video (Dealer Mode, 跨文件) | normal: 從清單選 Showroom Demo Video → 載入並播放(影音輸出)(DEAL-026) | abnormal: Exit Lock 開啟時:播放中不可退出,須播完才退(DEAL-028/028-01);若設 repeat 則循環播放(DEAL-028-02) | boundary: 點火循環:Demo 不跨點火循環續播,重開後不自動恢復(DEAL-030);清除個資會移除 Demo Video 並停用(DEAL-027/027-01)

- name: Player sources | enum: ['External CD', 'HU AUX(無控制)', 'HU USB', 'HU BTSA'] | source: Media HMI PC1.3
- name: Alphajump 字元 | enum: ['只啟用清單首字母存在的字元'] | source: SWE1-PLA-014-03/016-03
- name: Browse 選取 | enum: ['menu item(進子選單)', 'playable item(開始播放)'] | source: SWE1-PLA-018-01/02
- name: Demo Video 行為(Dealer Mode, 跨文件) | enum: ['播放:載入並播放影音(DEAL-026)', 'Exit Lock=ON:播放中不可退出,播完才退(DEAL-028-01)', 'Exit Lock=ON + repeat:循環播放(DEAL-028-02)', '點火循環後:不自動續播(DEAL-030)'] | source: 跨文件:CFTS012 Dealer Mode SWRA(NEWR1L-SWRA-DEAL-026/027/028/030);Player PLA-052 為指標型 stub
